original_test_intent: Verify that each Type 16 Error Correction enum accurately describes the physical memory array's designed correction capability, is consistent with related Type 17 width information and approved platform architecture, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete Type 16/17 records, bind raw and decoded Error Correction values to array handles, correlate linked device Total Width/Data Width and read-only ECC inventory, compare with the approved design without fault injection, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the ECC design baseline and reboot plan. No injected error, DIMM action or manual observation is part of this metadata test.
required_inputs: Expected Type 16 Error Correction enum for each array
Platform ECC architecture, including devices/arrays that intentionally lack correction
Expected Type 17 Total Width versus Data Width relationships and exceptions
Policy for None, Unknown, Other and vendor-specific enum values
Validated dmidecode/read-only ECC tools and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS, EDAC and OS inventory only; never inject correctable or uncorrectable errors.
Do not change ECC settings, memory policy, DIMM population or firmware.
Do not claim live correction effectiveness from descriptive SMBIOS and width metadata alone.
Bind all evidence to the same array and devices; report missing or contradictory links explicitly.
Stop on design ambiguity or reboot failure; do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode each array's raw Error Correction enum, resolve Type 17 links and widths, correlate approved read-only ECC context, and compare pre/post reboot state.
Do not inject faults, alter memory state or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the per-array ECC enum, architecture, width relationships and exceptional-value handling.
Approve reboot/recovery and render the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded field is relevant, but grep -A1 omits record handle, raw enum, other arrays and supporting Type 17 widths.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16 and Type 17 output; report each array's handle, raw/decoded correction enum and linked devices' Total Width/Data Width, plus labeled read-only ECC context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Error Correction scope, Type 16 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing and any error injection are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate raw Type 16 Error Correction enums per handle, resolve Type 17 devices and width relationships, compare the approved architecture and repeat read-only collection after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems exposing SMBIOS Type 16 arrays and Type 17 memory devices.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode, kernel and EDAC/tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16 Error Correction enumeration and Type 17 width semantics, plus the authoritative platform ECC design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum, array identity, complete record coverage and supporting device-width correlation to the isolated label.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong-array assignment, unsupported enum values, contradictory device widths and missing/duplicate links while avoiding unsafe injection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-array ECC baseline and width/exception policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware metadata and width differences describe design; they do not prove runtime correction, patrol scrub or error-reporting behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve different correction designs per array or device class, but must document exceptions and keep descriptive metadata distinct from a separate active fault-injection qualification plan.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, per-array correction enum and ECC/width policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/17 records with handles and widths
Per-array enum decode, resolved device links and any contradictions or exceptions
Read-only OS/EDAC inventory labeled as corroboration; explicit statement that no fault was injected
Approved reboot/health evidence and complete post-reboot comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The named Error Correction field has clear descriptive semantics; absent ECC design values are project inputs rather than a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Collection and structural/design comparison are safely automatable after approved inputs; active fault injection is not required by this row.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, per-array identity, complete topology and width/ECC correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-injection safeguards and supporting evidence while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates descriptive metadata validation from live error-correction qualification and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Avoids both false confidence from one decoded label and unsafe scope expansion into injected memory errors.
independent_technical_reasoning: The target is a finite SMBIOS enum whose identity, cross-record consistency and persistence can be machine-checked; proof of live correction is a different test intent.
